neighbours.label: cell organelle names in cell biology (endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi, peroxisome, mitochondria), especially the token after them
fire: The protein is folded inside the endoplasmic reticulum before it is shipped out.
Vesicles carry the enzyme from the Golgi apparatus to the cell membrane.
Fatty acids are broken down in the peroxisome of liver cells.
Calcium is stored in the smooth endoplasmic reticulum (SER) of muscle fibers.
The mutant cells had swollen mitochondria and a fragmented Golgi.
Ribosomes bound to the rough endoplasmic reticulum make secreted proteins.
Lysosomes digest worn-out organelles in a process called autophagy.
The dye stained the nucleus and the endoplasmic reticulum of each neuron.
quiet: The protein is folded slowly before it is shipped out of the factory.
Trucks carry the enzyme from the plant to the hospitals in town.
Fatty acids are broken down in the liver during long fasts.
Calcium is stored in bones and released when blood levels fall.
The mutant mice were smaller and lived shorter lives.
Proteins in milk are made by cells of the mammary gland.
Bacteria in the soil digest dead leaves over the winter.
The dye stained the tissue sample a deep purple color.
